- Excellent organisational and time-management skills
- The ability to prioritise and manage competing deadlines

- Excellent client-care skills
- A high level of accuracy and attention to detail

title: Conveyancing Legal Secretary
description:

Working closely with the Head of Department, you will provide essential support across a busy residential conveyancing caseload, gaining valuable hands-on experience and developing your knowledge within a supportive and professional environment.

This role would suit someone with previous legal or conveyancing experience who is organised, proactive and keen to build a long-term career in residential property.

The Role

You will play a key role in supporting the smooth running of the residential conveyancing department, with responsibilities including:
- Providing day-to-day administrative and legal support to the Head of Department across a busy caseload.
- Opening new files, completing client onboarding and undertaking identity verification and anti-money laundering checks.
- Preparing client care letters, instruction documentation and reports.
- Ordering and reviewing property searches and raising initial enquiries.
- Preparing draft contract packs and assisting with title reviews and pre-contract enquiries.
- Assisting with transfer documentation, completion statements and Stamp Duty Land Tax (SDLT) returns.
- Preparing Land Registry applications and managing post-completion matters, including registration and file closure.
- Liaising regularly with clients, estate agents, mortgage lenders and other solicitors, ensuring clients are kept informed throughout the transaction.
- Monitoring file progress, chasing outstanding documentation and maintaining accurate case management records.
- Assisting with diary management, correspondence and dictation where required.
- Ensuring all files are maintained in accordance with regulatory requirements and the firm's internal procedures.

About You

The successful candidate will be professional, well organised and committed to delivering excellent client service. You will ideally have:
- Previous experience in a conveyancing or legal support role, although candidates with the right attitude and aptitude will also be considered.
- A basic understanding of the residential conveyancing process.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a confident and approachable manner.
- A high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
- A proactive, dependable and professional approach to your work.
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office; experience using a legal case management system would be advantageous.
- The ability to work collaboratively and provide effective support to a senior colleague.
- A genuine willingness to learn, develop and progress within the conveyancing sector.

The Opportunity

Working directly alongside the Head of Department, this is an excellent opportunity to gain practical experience, broaden your understanding of residential conveyancing and develop your skills within an established legal practice.

If you are looking to join a respected law firm where you can make a valuable contribution to a busy team while building your career in property law, we would be delighted to hear from you.

Interested in finding out more? Apply today to discuss this opportunity in confidence.

description:
Property Maintenance and Legal Administrator

Whitstable, Kent

Company Description / Summary

We are a new and expanding Block and Estate Managing Agent. With a small, experienced team and an established client base, we are recruiting for an enthusiastic, customer focused team player to join us as a Property Management Administrator to help us deliver the high standards our clients are accustomed to. We are extremely well rated, thanks to the efforts of our team who put customer service at the heart of what we do. We deliver an excellent service by ensuring our staff are well trained, and that we can impart some of that knowledge onto our clients as well. We pride ourselves on being friendly, approachable and transparent in all aspects of our work, letting our clients know that they can have faith in our integrity and ability to manage their property professionally. We are looking for someone who will fit into our values and would like a long-term position in a company that fosters professional growth and education.

What You ll Do

You will work in a small team dealing with all aspects of block and estate management. Our company is responsible for looking after the communal areas in apartment buildings and housing estates, and ensuring they are safe, clean well maintained.

The role is extremely varied, and every day presents a different challenge, despite having two primary focus points day-to-day. There are lots of options for site visits and client meetings out of the office to change the pace of office-based work. Your typical day will probably include:
- Receive phone calls and emails from clients and contractors, and to investigate enquiries to be able to fully respond.
- Work within your team to gain practical experience in diagnosing and fixing a range of issues.
- Log repairs and actions and monitor ongoing progress and update clients and contractors.
- Liaise with suppliers and contractors to investigate, understand and remedy faults and problems, and to complete routine maintenance requirement.
- Arrange service contracts and risk assessments.
- Assist Property Managers to complete information packs and general administration in relation to property sales.

Person Requirements:
- Polite and respectful, with good verbal and written communication.
- Willing and confident to handle phone calls and email in a client facing role.
- Positive and proactive can-do attitude to work.
- Eager and motivated to learn and problem solve.
- Able to work with a high level of detail to deadlines.
- Good organisational skills and keen to take on responsibility.
- English and Mathematics four or higher.

Training

Property Management related training available, from TPI courses to apprenticeships, while experience is preferred in the following:
- Residential Leasehold Law.
- Land Registry requirements, including Certificates of Compliance.
- Conveyancing process.
- Block management process pre- and post-completion, including LPE1 / FME1 paperwork.
- Deeds of Variation and Lease Extensions.
- Building Safety Act requirements, especially in connection with property sales.
- Companies House requirements, including confirmation statements, accounts and officers.

Offer:
- 37.5hrs per week
- £26,000 £30,000 per annum
- Up to 20 days leave plus bank holidays
- Birthday off
- Company pension
- Fully office based, with the option to move to hybrid working after probation
- Become a valued member of a small, fast-growing team focused on employee wellbeing and personal growth
- Scope to make an impact in the company as it develops, with potential to progress as a Property Manager or Property Solicitor, and beyond
